tools.name: join-server
tools.description: Send a bot into a Minecraft server and wait until it has spawned. A bot already running under this name is used as it is; otherwise one is started, which in a cluster means the operator creates it. A fabric client takes about a minute to link, longer than one call waits: a call that runs out of patience says the bot is still starting, and calling join-server again with the same arguments waits for that bot rather than starting another. A failure says how far it got, because a bot that never started and a server that refused the login have different fixes.
